name: Pizzeria Paparazzi
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Paparazzi in Tirol** Welcome to **Pizzeria Paparazzi** in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic Italian flavors meet Alpine charm. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a fresh **Caprese**, our handmade pizzas are baked to perfection in a traditional wood-fired oven. Pair your meal with a crisp **Radler**, a refreshing **Aperol Spritz**, or one of our locally sourced **Tiroler Weine**. For dessert, indulge in our famous **Tiramisu** or a slice of **Kaiserschmarrn**—a sweet, fluffy treat with a **Tiroler** twist. Located near **Innsbruck**, we’re the perfect stop for pizza lovers exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Come taste the sun, even when it’s not shining! --- **Opening Hours:** Mon–Thu: 12:00–23:00 Fri–Sat: 12:00–01:00 Sun: 10:00–22:00 --- **Visit us online** or find us at: **
Hauptstraße 45, 6020 Innsbruck, Tirol
